name: 原则：编排可验证单元
description_zh: 多步工作（扫描、迁移、成批相似编辑）以及提交/PR 堆叠时：把工作拆成都以可验证状态收尾的小单元，逐个检查后再下一步，并按能让审查者自行证明的顺序交付。
description_en: Apply to multi-step work (sweeps, migrations, runs of similar edits) and to how you stack commits and PRs. Break work into small units that each end in a verifiable state, check each before the next, and order delivery so the sequence proves itself to a reviewer.
